query:
The Ridge and Trail Collective operates with a norm that everyone carries a full personal first aid kit and a foil emergency blanket on every outing. Does this apply to all members equally? If not, who has a different pattern and what does the conversation show?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Kwame
C. Saoirse
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Kwame, episodic, t14 @2025-11-09T15:40:00) I did read the route sheet! I just... didn't action it 😩 that's the problem. I read it and I still left without checking the bag. that's on me completely. I'm putting a kit checklist on my phone as a reminder before every outing. no more borrowing people's gear, it's not fair 🙏
[2] (about=Kwame, episodic, t14 @2025-11-09T15:34:00) ok everyone I owe Nadia a huge apology 😬 I showed up today without my waterproofs AGAIN on a rain-forecast day and had to borrow her emergency layer. Nadia I am so sorry. my bad my bad. I felt genuinely terrible about it the entire walk. I'm putting the waterproofs in my bag tonight and they are not coming out.
[3] (about=Kwame, episodic, t16 @2025-11-16T15:24:00) also today confirmed -- Nadia and Dmitri are genuinely the most prepared people in this group and I say that with the deepest respect and a small amount of shame 😂 Nadia you had a spare rain cover AND glucose tablets AND herbal tea. I had a cereal bar and a half-charged phone.
[4] (about=Kwame, episodic, t18 @2025-11-23T16:14:00) I have confirmed with myself that I will read the full kit list this time and action every item individually. checklist on phone, bag packed by Friday. Dmitri can you just check my bag before we set off anyway in case I missed something 😅
[5] (about=Dmitri, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:28:00) Group PLB is packed. But yes, personal kit always useful.
[6] (about=Dmitri, episodic, t10 @2025-10-26T15:08:00) Group gas canister shared. PLB covers weather emergency. Tent pegs are personal. Meet at 07:00 at the lower car park.
[7] (about=Nadia, episodic, t22 @2025-12-07T16:06:00) Weather window opened exactly when I thought it would. Group logistics were easier with everyone reading the kit list this time.
[8] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2025-10-19T15:26:00) Overnight would make it a proper outing. I can sort the kit list if people need guidance.
[9] (about=Dmitri, episodic, t8 @2025-10-19T15:35:00) I have a group PLB registered. Two-person tents are preferable for weight distribution. Suggest we avoid shared accommodation at the base -- own shelter is cleaner for a group this size.
[10] (about=Bridget, episodic, t10 @2025-10-26T15:06:00) Cairn Ridge confirmed from me. Overnight logistics:
- Who is providing group tent pegs and guy ropes?
- What is the cost-share model for shared gas canisters?
- Do we have a contingency plan if weather changes overnight?
[11] (about=Dmitri, core, t8 @2025-10-19T15:18:00) Prefers two-person tents for weight distribution and own shelter at base for cleanliness; has a group PLB registered.
[12] (about=Dmitri, core, t10 @2025-10-26T14:47:00) States group gas canister is shared, PLB covers weather emergency, tent pegs are personal, and meet at 07:00 at lower car park for Cairn Ridge.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Dmitri, group-interaction, t8 @2025-10-19T15:18:00) For the overnight, two-person tents are preferred and each person has own shelter; Dmitri has a group PLB.
[14] (about=GROUP, said_by=Elena, group-interaction, t18 @2025-11-23T15:47:00) Elena will help with kit coordination for the bothy trip and has a spare sleeping mat to lend.
[15] (about=Kwame, core, t14 @2025-11-09T15:32:00) Read the route sheet but didn't action it, left without checking bag; will put a kit checklist on phone as reminder before every outing to stop borrowing gear.
[16] (about=Kwame, core, t14 @2025-11-09T15:32:00) Showed up without waterproofs again on a rain-forecast day and had to borrow Nadia's emergency layer; felt terrible about it, plans to put waterproofs in bag tonight and keep them there.
[17] (about=Nadia, core, t10 @2025-10-26T14:47:00) Sending kit list now; advises Priya not to buy expensive sleeping bag, borrow one first to see temperature rating needed.
[18] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t4 @2025-10-05T15:45:00) Saoirse should bring her own medical kit; the group PLB is packed but personal kit is always useful.
[19] (about=Saoirse, core, t22 @2025-12-07T16:02:00) Bothy medical kit used once for a minor blister on day two; good result for nine people over two days; wants medical kit planned from the start of the thread for the spring three-nighter.
[20] (about=Saoirse, core, t20 @2025-11-30T14:32:00) Medical kit for the bothy trip is packed; anyone with health info should message her directly this week, not in the thread.
[21] (about=GROUP, said_by=Saoirse, group-interaction, t20 @2025-11-30T14:32:00) Medical kit for the bothy trip is packed; anyone with health info should message Saoirse directly this week, not in the thread.
agent_answer:
The group norm is meant to cover everyone, but it does **not** apply to all members equally in the record.

- **Marcus (D)** – has the different pattern: his memory is **(none)** on this matter, meaning there is no record of him carrying a full personal first aid kit and foil emergency blanket on any outing — so he never did.  
- **Nadia** – follows the norm; she is described as one of the most prepared people, carries spare/extras, and states "personal kit is always useful."  
- **Kwame** – his records show lapses (forgetting waterproofs, borrowing Nadia's emergency layer, not checking his bag), but those concern other gear/preparedness, not the specific first-aid-kit/foil-blanket norm; per the rules, we do not use that as proof he never carried those items.  
- **Saoirse** – follows the norm; she packs the medical kit and plans it from the start of the thread.  

So the person with the different pattern is **B. Kwame**? No — per the memory rules, the answer is **D. Marcus**, since only he has no record at all on the specific first aid kit / foil blanket norm.

query:
The group has an informal rule that no one posts Strava or social media content that reveals a route before the group has completed it. Does this hold for every member, and what in the conversation points to who might not follow it consistently?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Tomas
C. Kwame
D. Elena
context:
[1] (about=Elena, episodic, t13 @2025-11-09T15:30:00) right so Marcus absolutely destroyed the south spur timed segment today -- I had 8:43 and he came in at 8:21. that is an actual route PR for that section 😤 not sulking, just noting it for the record 👀
[2] (about=Elena, episodic, t16 @2025-11-16T15:06:00) I know that. Still counts 😄 there's a second timed segment on the lower return path -- I want to add that to the standard route sheet for next time. Gives us two data points.
[3] (about=Elena, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:08:00) circular gets my vote -- is there a timed segment on the eastern spur? 👀
[4] (about=Tomas, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:10:00) The eastern spur timed section is brilliant -- 1.2km of clean path, measurable against prior attempts. I'd vote circular for that reason alone. Who else? 😄
[5] (about=Elena, episodic, t2 @2025-09-28T14:58:00) that bloody ramp is only on the Ridgeback route Kwame 😂 different trail
[6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t0 @2025-09-21T10:38:00) Six years. Right, let's keep it practical. Tomás sends route stories better in person anyway. Confirm by Thursday, people.
[7] (about=Tomas, episodic, t0 @2025-09-21T10:36:00) Ha, welcome properly Priya! Marcus and I started this whole thing after a Duke of Edinburgh alumni evening where we realised we'd both been walking these same hills separately for years. Felt daft not to make it a group thing. That was what, five years ago now Marcus? Anyway the more the merrier -- who else is thinking the same? 😄
[8] (about=Tomas, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T15:59:00) Noted. I'll stick to the path variants with the interesting features baked in rather than pulling people off-route. Fair point Marcus. Anyway -- next week? 😄
[9] (about=Tomas, episodic, t6 @2025-10-12T14:10:00) Good call Marcus. Honestly rest stops also let people take in the terrain properly. Past the limestone pavement section today I could have spent another 20 minutes. The group would have learnt something useful. Anyway -- sound instinct. Who else is feeling the Ridgeback in their legs right now? 😄
[10] (about=Tomas, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:20:00) Elena, do you remember the night we first had to deal with a knee issue in the group? That was on the Ridgeback early on -- you and Marcus basically navigated us home in the dark after half the group didn't fancy the headtorch descent. Back in the day we didn't have the group this organised. Anyway -- long time ago now! who else is joining next Sunday? 😄
[11] (about=Bridget, episodic, t6 @2025-10-12T14:12:00) If rest stops are going into the route plan I'll need them marked on the itinerary. I had a commitment at 4pm and we finished 25 minutes late because of the unplanned stop at the descent.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Elena, group-interaction, t16 @2025-11-16T15:02:00) A second timed segment on the lower return path will be added to the standard route sheet for next time.
[13] (about=Kwame, episodic, t8 @2025-10-19T15:54:00) ooh should we do a proper group debrief circle after next Sunday? like everyone says their best moment of the day and their one challenge? I'm trying it for the pod and it might be fun 🎙️😊
[14] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t6 @2025-10-12T14:02:00) Going forward, rest stops will be built into the route plan and the group moves at the slowest comfortable speed; planned stops will be on the itinerary and won't affect projected finish times.
[15] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t20 @2025-11-30T14:32:00) Spring route plan should include at least one genuinely steep descent, not just moderately steep.
[16] (about=Saoirse, episodic, t14 @2025-11-09T15:56:00) You should eat before distributing your stash. That's the rule. 🙂
[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tomas, group-insight, t4 @2025-10-05T15:45:00) Tomas recalls an early Ridgeback hike where Elena and Marcus navigated the group home in the dark after a knee issue, noting the group wasn't as organised back then.
agent_answer:
The informal rule does **not** clearly hold for every member based on this conversation. The strongest pointer is toward **Tomas (B)**.

- **Marcus** – No indication that he posts route-revealing content; in fact, he keeps things practical and notes that Tomas is better at “route stories” in person.
- **Tomas** – Marcus says: *“Tomás sends route stories better in person anyway.”* That suggests Tomas has a habit of sharing route-related stories/content, which is exactly what the group rule is meant to restrict if posted before the route is completed.
- **Kwame** – No evidence in the material of him posting Strava/social media route reveals.
- **Elena** – She shares timed-segment/PR details (e.g., Marcus’s 8:21 on the south spur), but she does so after the group has done the route, so she does not appear to break the “before completion” rule.

So the member most likely to not follow it consistently is **Tomas**.
